text:
Anya (Product): Heads-up — ACME asked for a latency SLA for their chat integration. They want p95 < 120ms for typical prompts. Need cross-team triage on what we can commit to and what the fallback policy is. Can folks weigh in?

Sam (Eng-Runtime): On our side we can get close but current runtime p95 under pilot-ish load is ~130ms for the model variant they want. We can optimize batching and KV prefetch but there are throughput tradeoffs. :thinking_face:

Jasper (Infra): From infra: we can provision a reserved pool + prewarm hook. Disk IO on KV cache looked borderline on the last run. For isolation I'd prefer a dedicated pool for the pilot.

Maria (Eng-Platform): We can expose route-level toggles for the pilot: `prefetch=true`, `min_instances=3`, `quant_profile=bf16`. Will need a gated rollout and a config flag in the console. Example config snippet we can use for tests:
```json
{
  "route": "/acme-chat",
  "prefetch": true,
  "min_instances": 3,
  "quant_profile": "bf16"
}
```

Kevin (Security): Security asks: pilot needs a dedicated KMS key for audit logs plus documented retention for customer data. Also confirm there are no new inferencing logs containing sensitive PII before we go live.

Lucy (PM): ACME is willing to pay for a dedicated pool if we can prove latency in 6 weeks. Launch window is tight — need an acceptance checklist and rollout plan.

Sam (Eng-Runtime): Proposed plan summary: 1) pin model variant + quant profile; 2) route config + KV prewarm; 3) infra reserved pool; 4) run load tests with ACME prompt set and run evals. I can own the load tests and initial perf tuning. ETA: 4w for prototype if infra and platform changes are prioritized. :+1:

Jasper (Infra): I can scope the reserved pool and prewarm script. Quick Q: reuse existing reserved nodes or provision new? leaning new for customer isolation — cost will be higher.

Anya (Product): @Sam @Jasper @Maria @Kevin OK — can each of you own a checklist item and drop one-line deliverables here by EOD? I’ll compile a single playbook and schedule a follow-up. Acceptance criteria I want captured now: p95 < 120ms on ACME prompts, error-rate delta <= 0.1%, and audit/KMS + retention docs in place.

Sam (Eng-Runtime): Will do, I’ll post perf test plan and thresholds.

Maria (Eng-Platform): I’ll add the route flag and a console toggle PR.

Jasper (Infra): I’ll scope infra and send cost estimate.

Kevin (Security): I’ll sketch the KMS/audit requirements and checklist.

Lucy (PM): I’ll coordinate ACME expectations and share the prompt set.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: cross-team sync Monday 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent to attendees.
